title: Console progressive telemetry gating and acceptance gating for dashboards, tracing, and cost breakdown
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Decision record and acceptance criteria for cutting down initial console telemetry surface by introducing progressive feature gates and a rollback matrix. This ticket captures what is in-scope for the launch, what must be deferred or gated, non-negotiable SLOs, and operational controls for safe rollout.
background: PMs committed to a trimmed observability surface to meet launch deadlines after infra and runtime teams reported higher-than-expected instrument costs. Engineering proposed progressive gating (feature flags + server-side sampling + on-demand rehydration) to keep critical UX paths while deferring heavy-card surfaces. This document aligns PM/Eng/Design on the gating plan, acceptance criteria, and fallback behavior.
scope_inclusions: Core route-level latency and error-rate tiles (single-aggregate card per route)
Trace sampling integration with 1% default and per-route override UI control (toggle on console)
Per-route token cost estimate card (top-level aggregated values, no per-token breakdown)
Canary rollout path and manual enable toggle in Console admin settings
Basic drilldown to recent traces (first 3 spans) with link to full trace viewer in deferred mode
scope_exclusions: Large multi-card dashboards (>=6 widgets) and fully denormalized cost-explorer views
High-frequency real-time streaming tiles for token-level breakdowns
Automatic lineage and cross-product correlation (defer to Phase 2)
Deep per-token cost attribution and token heatmaps
Client-side SDK integrations for local sampling controls (deferred)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard time-to-first-paint <= 800ms on median and <= 1500ms at 95th for standard small org dataset
Core route tile renders successfully with fallbacks when telemetry unavailable (UI shows stale indicator + refresh action)
Trace drilldown returns a sampled trace within 5s of click for 95% of canary users when sampling enabled
Cost estimate card displays aggregated route cost with <= 5% relative error on synthetic validation against billing dataset
Feature gate toggles are controllable from Console admin and can be flipped without a code deploy
Canary population control supports targeting by workspace ID list and traffic percentage
Rollout has a documented rollback matrix and automated fallback to stable route variant when downstream sampling latency exceeds 10s
Automated health checks surface to on-call Slack channel when trace-service error rate > 2% for 10m
decisions: Ship a single condensed cost tile instead of per-route expansion in initial release to reduce query cardinality
Use server-side deterministic sampling at 1% by default; allow per-route override to 5% for selected routes during canary
Defer heavy-card telemetry such as streaming token-level cost breakdowns to Phase 2 to meet timeline
Expose manual admin feature flags in Console for safe progressive enablement and immediate rollback
tradeoffs: Reduced initial fidelity on cost and trace coverage in exchange for predictable query cost and faster UI performance
Increased complexity in release engineering due to gating controls, but lowers blast radius for incidents
Some developer/SE customers may request per-token insights earlier; will offer export hooks and invite beta partners for Phase 2
next_steps: Engineering to produce a lightweight query plan doc for condensed cost tile by 2025-02-18
Design to produce fallback states and microcopy for gated features by 2025-02-19
SRE to author health-check playbook and Slack alert routing by 2025-02-21
PM to schedule canary cohort and compose rollout runbook (target start 2025-02-24)
Create monitoring dashboard for sampling coverage and query latency (owner: Observability Eng)
notes: Requested by a large enterprise pilot worried about egress cost spikes: include explicit opt-out in admin
Plan includes a short-lived toggle that will be removed once Phase 2 rollout completes; document removal timeline
Acceptance tests will include synthetic traffic generator to validate sampling coverage and cost estimate accuracy
Keep communications template for customers ready in case canary reveals unexpected cost deltas
